title: DDIAS shields single-stranded DNA in mitosis and promotes vertebrate brain development.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC shows no open-access full text, no PMCID, no supplement, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/BioProject), no Zenodo/Dryad hits; only text-mined accessions are antibody RRIDs (research resource identifiers).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: mechanistic cell-biology study (DDIAS protein in the TOPBP1-CIP2A mitotic DNA-repair complex), a few patients with biallelic DDIAS mutations, cerebral organoids and zebrafish experiments.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found anywhere (no GEO/SRA/Zenodo/Dryad, no supplement in Europe PMC); paper is paywalled. Checked via repository links, not files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No tabular label exists; results are imaging and biochemistry experiments on one protein, not a labelled table.

a5_enough_rows.note: Single-gene mechanistic study with a handful of patients; no row count seen.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No downloadable data to compare against.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper provides no model-ready dataset, only experiments on one gene.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein features to predict which mitotic DNA-repair proteins matter for brain development — not supported by this paper's data.
plain_idea.train_on: Nothing usable: the paper deposits no table; example count unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Would need a measured label (e.g. neurodevelopmental-disorder gene status) from other resources, not this paper.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: The biology is interesting to DNA-repair and neurodevelopment labs, but this paper adds no training data.

ml_idea: None viable from this paper: mechanistic single-gene study with no deposited dataset.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check for any GEO/PRIDE deposit linked to the DOI — none found.

verdict_reason: Paywalled mechanistic cell-biology paper on one protein (DDIAS) with no deposited dataset, supplement or accession beyond antibody IDs; fails A1 (downloadable) and A2 (label as a column).
